DT.Categories.AbilityScoreProminence.Hin: Display tweaks for ability scores on dnd5e actor sheets. Per-user.
DT.Settings.AbilitySwapScoreAndMod.Name: Show Ability Score Large
DT.Settings.AbilitySwapScoreAndMod.Hint: Makes the score the large, prominent number and the modifier small. On the default dnd5e sheet the score also moves directly under the ability name. Also applies to the Tidy 5e Character Sheet (non-classic).
DT.Settings.AbilityExpandedRollTargets.H: Lets you click the ability score or modifier (not just the ability name) to roll an ability check. Applies to the D&D 5e Character Sheet only; the Tidy 5e Character Sheet always rolls on the large top button.
DT.Categories.SpellEffectAutoApply.Label: Spell Effect Auto-Apply (D&D 5e)
DT.Categories.SpellEffectAutoApply.Hint: Automatically applies the effects of self-cast spells, so nobody has to click "apply" on the chat card. Set by the GM for the whole world.
DT.Settings.SpellAutoApplyEnabled.Name: Auto-Apply Self-Cast Spell Effects
DT.Settings.SpellAutoApplyEnabled.Hint: When a whitelisted spell is cast on the caster themselves, apply its effects automatically instead of waiting for someone to press "apply" on the chat card. Only applies to spells with a range of Self or Touch that target the caster.
DT.Settings.SpellAutoApplyWhitelist.Name: Auto-Apply Spell Whitelist
DT.Settings.SpellAutoApplyWhitelist.Hint: Comma-separated spell names that may auto-apply, e.g. "Mage Armor, Shield of Faith". Names are matched exactly (ignoring upper/lower case).
